mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE rising > 0.2 percentage points in 3 months) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative equity market reaction within 5 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downward.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing contraction (INDPRO falling below 100 for 3 consecutive months), industrial output weakness signals reduced corporate capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100 for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1100 thousand units) indicate strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 1100 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL rising > 2.0% year-over-year) signals inflationary pressure, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 2.0% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates broad-based economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 60 trading days as corporate earnings forecasts are cut.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline > 0.5% from prior quarter
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline > 0.5% from prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS rising > 0.5% monthly and UNRATE falling below 5.0%), consumer spending and corporate profitability increase, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.5% monthly and UNRATE falls < 5.0%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS rises > 0.5% monthly and UNRATE falls < 5.0%.
